ruling.scope: Ben ruled on 2026-09-05 at 15:28, in his words: "228 - merge". This ruling authorises two protected paths. test/fixtures/readme-demo-checker-output.txt changes by one line, replacing the label "Kernel decision" with "Verifier-local verdict", leaving the verdict word REPRODUCED unchanged. test/fixtures/readme-demo-output.txt is BYTE-IDENTICAL to main; commit a745591 touched it and commit 0153576 reverted it, and the gate reports the touch because it walks every commit in the range. I observed the checker-output diff against origin/main as exactly one insertion and one deletion with only that label changed, and I observed zero output bytes from the demo-output diff against origin/main. I also derived matching demo-output blobs be528188bb8458b31a864e955559414e9ab29507 for HEAD and origin/main, and verified that a745591 changed that blob to e3aef9abec7d58637b77e66d5946b2d713d3fb40 before 0153576 restored be528188bb8458b31a864e955559414e9ab29507.
retires: The 2026-09-04 ruling on test/fixtures/rendercheck-accept.cast, base 9ccbcf58b6ef4c1e9f185cf31ed6ccea7faf24be, which landed on main as c57f26d1b9f24093f088c138e3cd1b4e674c24a5 with the exact recorded blob and no longer applies to any open change.
